role: General consideration, Data Privacy Avengers 2026 finalist
note: Requested by Robi's leadership panel after the Grand Pitch Day, so no job description exists. Tailored toward what that panel already saw rather than a specific posting: privacy and security engineering, voice and Bangla, customer contact governance, and accessibility. Shoulder is pinned because it is the one project that is about privacy as an architecture rather than a policy, which is the thing the contest was judging.
why: Fifth place and a Top 10 finish at Data Privacy Avengers 2026 with team TheCypherGirls. The work that followed it is in the same direction: systems where privacy is enforced by the shape of the data rather than by a promise, voice that works in Bangla over an ordinary phone line, and customer contact that stops when someone says they are in trouble.
